Implement tangent space generation with vertex splitting using meshopt

meshopt_generateTangents is used to generate per-corner tangent vectors.
For unindexed inputs, we then simply copy the result to the output. For
indexed inputs, we copy them into the existing vertices and split
vertices with divergent tangents on the fly.

Splitting may interfere with blend shapes as it may disturb shared
indexing. While it would be possible to propagate the split vector into
the blend shape code and apply it to the blend targets as well, for now
we simply avoid doing the splitting in the first place if the mesh has
blend shapes.

Script binding for generate_tangents uses pre-splitting behavior for
compatibility.

Editor: Add resumable download with retry for export templates

When downloading export templates, connection drops now trigger automatic retry with HTTP Range-based resume instead of failing permanently.

Add keep_partial_download and append_to_download_file properties to HTTPRequest so partial files can be preserved and resumed with 206 Partial Content responses. Use them in ExportTemplateManager to retry failed template downloads, resume ZIP fragments when possible, and report retry failures clearly.
